facts.business: Seya Industries Ltd is a company undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) with manufacturing operations suspended throughout FY 2025-26 and no revenue from operations during the year.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty in relation to Going Concern - The Company is undergoing CIRP, manufacturing operations remained suspended throughout FY 2025-26 with no revenue from operations, incurred loss before tax of ₹512.93 lakh and loss after tax of ₹287.41 lakh. Appropriateness of going concern basis dependent on outcome of CIRP and ability to revive operations.

key_risks: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) outcome uncertainty
No revenue from operations during the year
Material uncertainty casting significant doubt on ability to continue as going concern
Legal matters and non-provision of interest on borrowings
